content.short: Trust Wallet is a self-custody multi-chain wallet for Web3, NFTs, DeFi, swaps, and asset storage.
content.description: Trust Wallet is a self-custody crypto wallet for mobile and browser users. Its site describes true crypto ownership, support for many assets, dapp access, NFTs, DeFi, swaps, and privacy-focused wallet use. The TON listing reflects multi-chain wallet support rather than a TON-only app. Unlock the power of your cryptocurrency assets and explore the world of Web3 with Trust. The leading self-custody multi-chain platform. That shows up in features such as building on trust, one platform, millions of assets, browse a world of dapps, and zero personal tracking.
content.meta: Trust Wallet is a self-custody multi-chain wallet for Web3, NFTs, DeFi, swaps, and asset storage. Discover its TON role and related apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
